## functions

```{r}
#| label: filter-section-complete

filter_section_complete <- function(data, column) {
  section_complete <- dict |> 
    filter(field_name == column) |> 
    pull(form_name) |> 
    paste0("_complete")
  data |> 
    filter(.data[[section_complete]] == "2")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: get-question

get_question <- function(column) {
  dict |>
    filter(field_name == column) |>
    pull(field_label)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: get-choices

get_choices <- function(column) {
  matrix <- dict |> 
    filter(field_name == column) |>
    pull(choices) |>
    str_split_1(" \\| ") |>
    str_split_fixed(", ", n = 2)
  set_names(
    nm = matrix[ ,1],
    x = matrix[ ,2]
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: pivot-longer-1

pivot_longer_1 <- function(data, column) {
  prefix <- paste0(column, "___")
  data |>
    select(record_id, starts_with(prefix)) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -record_id,
      names_prefix = prefix,
      names_to = column,
      values_to = "is_selected",
    ) |>
    filter(is_selected == 1) |>
    select(-is_selected) |>
    mutate(across(all_of(column), fct_inseq))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: top

top <- function(data, n, drop_other = TRUE) {
  column <- names(data)[1]
  data <- data |> mutate(across(all_of(column), \(x) {
    x |> 
      fct_lump_n(n, count) |> 
      fct_reorder(-count)
  }))
  if (drop_other == FALSE) {
    data |> 
      count(.data[[column]], wt = count, name = "count") |> 
      mutate(pct = count / n_respondents[[column]])
  } else {
    data |> 
      filter_out(.data[[column]] == "Other")
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: other-if

other_if <- function(data, less_than_or_equal_to, include = NULL) {
  column <- names(data)[1]
  data <- data |> mutate(across(all_of(column), \(x) {
    x |> 
      fct_reorder(-count) |> 
      fct_lump_min(less_than_or_equal_to + 1, count)
  }))
  if (!is.null(include)) {
    data <- data |> mutate(across(all_of(column), \(x) {
      x |> 
        fct_other(drop = include)
    }))
  }
  data |> 
    count(.data[[column]], wt = count, name = "count") |> 
    mutate(pct = count / n_respondents[[column]])
}
```

```{r}
#| label: theme-1

theme_1 <- function(...) {
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(colour = scales::alpha("black", alpha = 0.65)),
      ...
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: ggplot-1

ggplot_1 <- function(
  data,
  geom_text_size = get_geom_defaults(geom_text)$size,
  drop_empty = TRUE
) {
  column <- names(data)[1]
  n <- n_respondents[[column]]
  data |>
    mutate(pct = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)(pct)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[column]], y = count, fill = .data[[column]])) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = str_glue("{count} ({pct})")),
      vjust = -0.5,
      size = geom_text_size
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(
      option = "viridis",
      guide = "none",
      drop = drop_empty
    ) +
    labs(subtitle = paste0("n = ", n)) +
    theme_1()
}
```
